cues: A grade twelve data description does three things.
It says what the visual shows, in your own words.
It names the pattern, in an overview sentence.
And it supports the pattern with figures.
It does not explain why the pattern happened, and gives no opinion.
The seven marks: three for content, two for organisation, two for language.
Write a hundred and fifty to two hundred words, in about fifteen minutes; three hundred words buys no extra mark, only more chances of error.
